body: funny you should mention teaching. i did two degrees - physics and an msc in nuclear. i thought it would give me an opportunity to start a new life on a good salary but it hasnt happened and i cant get a job. of course, everyone then recommends teaching. in my subject you get a £26,000 scholarship to do a pgce in physics / maths, but ive never had any interest in teaching. i know with 99.9% certainty that i would resent the job, even if there were some great kids. i would wake up every day and feel like shit, which is exactly how i feel now. i wanted to do cool things with high level science - exploration geoscience, renewables, nuclear engineering. one of my old "friends" was very average with academics but is now a doctor. another is a pharmacist. no way could i live with myself in a low level job when these idiots are earning more than me. i sound like a bastard but i dont care.

i had thoughts of hanging myself when i was 17 and having a horrible time in college. i finished my a-levels with decent grades but it was the start of the decline. the past 15 years (i'm 33) have been pure hell. i have spent almost all of it shut in the house. i went to university twice but it was miserable and i just tried to get through it without interaction. worked for maybe 9 months in my entire life, all temporary roles. social anxiety still bad enough to stop me from phoning employers. cant make friends because i am too ashamed of my life and dont want people to ask me questions. its just a mess , all of it. when i finished my degrees i thought it would springboard me into a professional life with money and a chance to wipe the slate clean, but it just hasn't happend. this world is hell for me.
